policies.name: tenant_document_download
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'aqari-documents'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (aqari_documents d
     JOIN aqari_tenants t ON (((t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id) AND (t.external_ref = d.entity_ref))))
  WHERE ((d.storage_path = objects.name) AND (d.storage_bucket = objects.bucket_id) AND (d.status = 'uploaded'::text) AND (d.document_type = 'tenant_attachment'::text) AND private.aqari_owns_tenant(t.workspace_id, t.id)))))

policies.name: v267_document_read
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'aqari-documents'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM aqari_documents d
  WHERE ((d.storage_path = objects.name) AND (d.storage_bucket = objects.bucket_id) AND private.aqari_can(d.workspace_id, 'documents'::text, 'read'::text) AND private.aqari_document_entity(d.workspace_id, d.entity_type, d.entity_ref, 'read'::text)))))

policies.name: v267_document_upload
policies.check:
((bucket_id = 'aqari-documents'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM aqari_documents d
  WHERE ((d.storage_path = objects.name) AND (d.storage_bucket = objects.bucket_id) AND (d.status = 'draft'::text) AND (d.created_by = auth.uid()) AND private.aqari_can(d.workspace_id, 'documents'::text, 'write'::text) AND private.aqari_document_entity(d.workspace_id, d.entity_type, d.entity_ref, 'write'::text)))))
